• Buy and customize vehicles
• Buy and decorate houses
• Get jobs and earn money
• PVP

games.name: [🏖️x2] One Shot
games.desc:
One Shot is a fast-paced FFA deathmatch where every gun holds a single bullet. Hit your shot or reload while someone lines you up.

🔫 One-shot guns, one bullet at a time
🌀 Slide and strafe to dodge, reposition, and outplay
🏆 Streaks, flicks, clutch reloads
🔥 No teams, no mercy, pure skill

🔓 Progress & Customization

- Roll cases for rare & limited weapon skins
- Level up and earn rewards as you play
- Climb the global leaderboards
- Daily quests for free loot

🎮 Platform Support

PC 💻 | Mobile 📱 | Console 🎮
(Xbox & PlayStation supported)

👍 Enjoying the game?
Leave a thumbs-up, it helps a lot!

Cheating, exploiting, or farming with alts will result in a permanent ban. No appeals.
